name: com.bestofmotivation/best-of-motivation
title: Best Of Motivation
description: Best Of Motivation: free work quizzes (Colour, Leadership Style, Thinker, AI) and practical articles

tools.name: search_bom_articles
tools.description: Find Best Of Motivation articles that answer a question about leadership, managing a team, habits, productivity, personal growth, money or using AI at work. Use when the user asks for practical advice on these topics or asks what Best Of Motivation says about something. Returns up to 5 articles with title, URL, summary and the most relevant excerpt. Do not use it when the user wants to take a quiz: use the matching start_*_quiz tool instead.

query.description: The user's question or topic in plain words, e.g. 'how to give feedback to a defensive employee'.

limit.description: How many articles to return (1-5). Default 3.

tools.name: start_leadership_style_quiz
tools.description: Start the Best Of Motivation Leadership Style Quiz (15 questions, about 5 minutes). Use when the user wants to find out their leadership or management style, or asks for a leadership quiz. Returns the questions. Ask them one at a time, showing every option exactly as written with its letter, and record the letter the user picks. Do not tell the user which style an option points to, and do not guess the result yourself: when all 15 are answered, call score_leadership_style_quiz.

tools.name: score_leadership_style_quiz
tools.description: Score the Best Of Motivation Leadership Style Quiz once the user has answered all 15 questions from start_leadership_style_quiz. Pass the letters in question order. Returns the user's leadership style and a link to take the quiz on the site for the free personalised report. After scoring, reply only with the result lines the tool returns: no strengths, blind spots or advice of your own.

answers.description: The 15 letters the user chose, in question order, e.g. ["A","C",...]. Questions 1-14 use A-D; question 15 uses A-E.

tools.name: start_ai_working_style_quiz
tools.description: Start the Best Of Motivation AI Working Style Quiz (10 questions, about 2 minutes). Use when the user wants to find out how they should use AI at work, their AI working style, or asks for an AI quiz. Returns the questions and a quiz_key. Ask them one at a time, showing every option exactly as written with its letter, and record the letter the user picks. Do not tell the user which result an option points to and do not guess the result yourself: when all 10 are answered, call score_ai_working_style_quiz with the letters and the quiz_key.

tools.name: score_ai_working_style_quiz
tools.description: Score the Best Of Motivation AI Working Style Quiz once the user has answered all 10 questions from start_ai_working_style_quiz. Pass the quiz_key from the start call and the 10 letters in question order. Returns the user's AI working style and a link to the free full result on the site. After scoring, reply only with the result lines the tool returns: no strengths, blind spots or advice of your own.

answers.description: The 10 letters the user chose, in question order.
